raw_text: But node-scoped does not make any sense because an app is very generic. Only the app instances are node-scoped, and the workspaces. But the apps are not. The apps are generic because they can have multiple instances that sit on different nodes. So it does not make any sense to make the apps node-scoped.

expectation: List logical apps globally and derive caller visibility from concrete app instances.

protection.rejected_example: app:list resolves or accepts a node and filters logical apps through apps.node_id.
protection.accepted_example: app:list has no node input and returns each logical app once when at least one authorized concrete instance is visible.
